senses.gloss: maccha (Pali id.), MIndic for Skt. matsya, fish: Mv 〔i.15.10〕.
macchara (Pali id.), MIndic for Skt. matsara, envious: a-m˚ RP 〔37.17〕 (vs). Cf. next.

maccharī (-jātaka), so read in colophon Mv 〔ii.64.7〕 for text maṃjarī˚; MIndic for Skt. matsarin (cf. prec.), the selfish man. The main character in the Pali version, Jāt. 〔535〕, is called Macchari-kosiya (once ˚iká), Jāt. 〔v.383.14 ff.〕 Cf. prec.
